limitations: Matching debug toolchains, old then new sequentially for three repetitions; no concurrent compilation or heavy tests from this task. External system activity is not controlled.
First reads use reopened stores and warm OS cache. Three first-read samples per scenario are not a robust population p95; raw values and reopen time retained.
Direct admitted batches do not simulate provider arrival cadence, queue backlog or native UI frame/input/cancel latency.
Full transcript digests cover IDs, types, roles and content; exclude volatile envelope timestamps. All expected thinking, arguments and tool outputs asserted.
Database allocations are complete dbstat page sums, not stream_* name buckets. WAL metric is logical cache-write page bytes, not device I/O.
No historical compression, VACUUM, widened durability window or reduced FULL synchronization.
